name: Hexenzeit Appartements
beschreibung: The Hexenzeit Appartements are located at Stampfanger 1 in Söll within Tyrol's Wilder Kaiser holiday region, situated right beside the valley gondola station of Söll. These modern, generously sized holiday apartments offer exceptional comfort for two to four guests, featuring fully equipped kitchenettes with dishwashers, welcoming living lounges, separate bedrooms, satellite TV, free Wi-Fi, and sunny balconies looking directly onto the Hohe Salve and the Wilder Kaiser cliffs. In winter, visitors benefit from genuine ski-in/ski-out convenience, stepping right into the expansive SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser–Brixental. In summer, the famous Hexenwasser mountain adventure park is literally on the doorstep. Söll's village centre with its shops and eateries is an easy walk away.
kurzbeschreibung: Modern holiday apartments on Stampfanger in Söll at the Wilder Kaiser with fully equipped kitchens and direct access to the SkiWelt.
